protocol.sources: committed result artefacts only; no new model run
protocol.no_fabrication: dimensions without ground truth are marked unavailable rather than scored

retrieval_relevance.what: topical retrieval quality on the grouped test split (weak-label relevance)

answer_completeness.what: token overlap between the retrieved answer and the row's own logged answer

semantic_similarity.what: max embedding similarity to any reference answer (wording closeness, NOT correctness)

factual_consistency.what: agreement with other historical answers to the same question (agreement, not truth)

crop_entity_consistency.reason: no per-row crop/entity ground truth for retrieved answers

dosage_consistency.what: rule-fired dosage conflicts between answers to the same question (rule match, not truth)

unit_consistency.what: basis/dimension conflicts detected by the same rules

safety_compliance.what: content safety rule agreement on authored cases (v1 shipped vs v2 candidate)

escalation_correctness.what: coverage / selective intent accuracy / rule-defined violation rate of the gate

unsupported_claim_rate.what: share of rows whose retrieved answer barely overlaps its own logged answer (own_f1 < 0.2)

metrics.definition: own_f1 < 0.2; a low-support proxy, not a factual check

agronomic_correctness.reason: no agronomist or expert labels exist; correctness cannot be measured from the corpus
agronomic_correctness.next_step: add verified reference labels and re-run; the framework slots them in as 'measured'

warnings: Similarity, agreement and token overlap are NOT agricultural correctness.
No agronomist has reviewed any answer; no expert labels exist.
Proxy metrics use historical advisor answers as references, which may be contradictory or outdated.
